request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Frontend and backend maintenance and development for Eternl across web, browser extension, Android, and iOS
Backend infrastructure operations including multi-region servers, Cardano node operation, DBSync/indexers, application services, monitoring, alerting, and incident response
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public channels, 1-on-1 ecosystem project support, wiki updates, and educational videos
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
Independent audits of treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027, plus oversight metrics for balances, conversion rates, transaction hashes, and repayment hashes
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements while Eternl introduces paid Pro plans intended to reach sustainability.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet for web, browser extension, Android, and iOS used for payments, staking, governance, and DApp interaction.
The proposal requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 in annual costs for 6.0 FTE across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl plans to introduce Personal Pro at $96 per year and Company Pro at $360 per year, and asserts that about 5,500 users, or 4.2% of its install base, would fully cover the $420,000 annual cost.
The proposer states Eternl has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.

The proposer says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, deposit it into a public company wallet, return any Ada above that amount to the treasury, and keep pre-conversion funds auditable, undelegated to SPOs, and delegated to abstain voting.

The proposal commits to independent fund-use audits by a party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or Eternl in February 2027 and August 2027, covering custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro income relevant to repayment, and refunds or repayments.

The proposal commits to semiannual repayment checks in December and June, using 100% of surplus treasury stablecoins plus paid-plan income above $420,000 to repay up to $420,000 in Ada, then donating 50% of Pro income above $420,000 until an additional $210,000 in Ada is donated.
The proposer asserts that 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The proposer states the main Eternl UI will not be open-source, while some libraries used in Eternl will be published through the Eternl npm organization.

The proposer says that without treasury funding it may let developers go, scale Eternl down to essential maintenance, shift focus outside Cardano, and potentially remove the free option if paid licenses are insufficient beyond August.

summary: The document presents a ₳2,350,000 request for a 12-month continuation of Eternl operations, with a sustainability plan based on paid Pro subscriptions, public custody and refund commitments, fund-use audits, and semiannual repayment mechanics, but many adoption and counterfactual-risk claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
